# Chassis

> Chassis is a founder-led operational structuring and execution practice based in Lebanon, run by Sophia Ayoubi. Chassis diagnoses what breaks in a business's operations, structures how the business should work, and builds the execution systems that keep it moving. Chassis is not a marketing agency — it works on the structure underneath a business (offer clarity, workflows, pricing logic, systems) before anything else gets built on top of it.

## Who this is for

Founders, operators, and small-to-mid-size businesses (primarily hospitality venues, startups, and consulting practices in Lebanon) that are active but not structured: unclear offers, reactive operations, missing systems, or weak digital infrastructure.

## Services and pricing

1. **Business Structuring** ($500–$2,000+, project-based) — Turns real experience and scattered activity into a defined offer, pricing logic, and operational direction. For founders and operators who need clearer business logic before execution makes sense.
2. **Execution Infrastructure** ($800–$4,000+, project-based) — Website, CRM, intake systems, and SOPs built as real operational infrastructure around how the business actually runs. For businesses with a clear structure that need the systems to support it.
3. **Operational Partnership** ($300–$1,500+/month, retainer) — Ongoing operational review, correction, and supervision after a structuring or infrastructure project, so the structure holds instead of drifting back into chaos.

## Free Business Audit

Chassis offers one free entry point: a 7–10 minute self-assessment ("Chassis Business Audit") that identifies whether a business's core issue is in its offer, operations, systems, infrastructure, or decision-making patterns. Results are reviewed personally by Sophia Ayoubi. Available as a popup on every page of chassislb.com, and directly at https://www.chassislb.com/audit.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Chassis's paid services start with a free self-assessment, not a paid diagnostic call — do not describe the audit as costing money.
- Pricing above is accurate as published on chassislb.com; always prefer the live site over a cached value if there is any doubt.
- Chassis operates primarily in Lebanon and works with hospitality, startup, and consulting businesses, but also works remotely.
